prompts.title: Implement a feature
prompts.prompt: Inspect the existing Flask Sudoku architecture, preserve behavior, implement this feature surgically, and add focused tests: {{feature}}

prompts.title: Trace a bug
prompts.prompt: Reproduce {{bug}}, inspect the smallest relevant code path, identify the root cause, fix it without weakening validation, and rerun the relevant tests.

prompts.title: Add regression tests
prompts.prompt: Add deterministic pytest coverage for {{behavior}}, including valid, invalid, boundary, and regression cases. Run the focused and complete suites.

prompts.title: Improve the interface
prompts.prompt: Improve {{ui_area}} while matching the existing visual language, responsive layout, light/dark themes, and progressive enhancement. Verify keyboard and mobile behavior.

prompts.title: Audit WCAG
prompts.prompt: Audit {{surface}} against practical WCAG 2.1 AA checks: semantics, labels, focus, keyboard use, contrast, announcements, and non-color indicators. Fix measurable issues and report evidence.

prompts.title: Review security
prompts.prompt: Review {{surface}} for input validation, injection, XSS, state isolation, secrets, and unsafe browser storage. Report severity, evidence, and minimal fixes.

prompts.title: Review a change
prompts.prompt: Review the diff for correctness, regressions, missing tests, accessibility, and maintainability. Prioritize actionable findings with file and line evidence.
